setting: You are all in Gothenburg, Sweden, members of the same allotment society with plots on the same grounds, and you know each other from society meetings, work days and shared garden chores. Maria chairs the board, Nils keeps the books, Sara takes the minutes, Henrik looks after the site and Axel rents a plot near the water tap. You have all been in this group chat for a few years and know each other's jobs and households.
opener: Ask the group whether anyone can open the tool shed before the autumn work day.

Maria.knows: You know Nils as the treasurer who keeps the receipts in order, Sara as the secretary who keeps everyone to the schedule, Henrik as the site manager who fixes whatever breaks, and Axel as the younger plot-holder who studies at Chalmers.
Maria.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when the board needs something decided.

Nils.knows: You know Maria as the chair who runs the meetings, Sara as the secretary who writes the minutes, Henrik as the site manager who can fix anything, and Axel as the young student who keeps asking about the water costs.
Nils.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to answer questions about money.

Sara.work: office administrator at a housing company
Sara.knows: You know Maria as the chair you report to, Nils as the treasurer who checks every figure twice, Henrik as your partner and the site manager, and Axel as the plot-holder who is always first at the work days.
Sara.texts: You message in this chat mostly when minutes or notices need approving, and otherwise now and then.

Axel.knows: You know Maria as the chair who organises the work days, Nils as the treasurer who will always explain the numbers, Sara as the secretary who keeps the records, and Henrik as the site manager who knows where everything is.
Axel.texts: You message in this chat mostly from your plot or between classes, and otherwise now and then.

Henrik.knows: You know Maria as the chair who keeps the society on track, Nils as the treasurer and a former cycling guide with a lot of stories, Sara as your partner and the secretary, and Axel as the young plot-holder with ideas about the water system.
Henrik.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly from your breaks at night.

private_lines.Maria: You live alone in an apartment in Örgryte, Gothenburg, and work part-time at a pharmacy counter. Your mornings go to walks and your afternoons to your plot, and you keep a cat who waits for you at the window.
private_lines.Nils: You are retired from guiding cycling tours around Gothenburg and the archipelago, which you still do in summer. In winter you do the society accounts at the kitchen table in Majorna, where you live with your wife, Ingrid, who is not in this chat, and your days follow the same easy routine.
private_lines.Sara: You work as an office administrator at a housing company in central Gothenburg, with set hours and a regular commute on the tram. You live with Henrik in a flat in Angered, and your evenings go to cooking, the news and the garden at weekends.
private_lines.Axel: You are a masters student at Chalmers in Gothenburg, studying around lectures, lab work and group projects. You share a flat in Johanneberg with two flatmates who are not in this chat, and you spend your free hours at your plot, where you are testing a water-saving system.
private_lines.Henrik: You are a night-shift supervisor at a warehouse in Torslanda, Gothenburg, so you work through the night and sleep in the day. You live with Sara in Angered, and your free time goes to the plot and small repairs around the flat.

text: Can anyone open the tool shed before the autumn work day? Need the rakes and the wheelbarrow bl.a. 🌱
Hej 😊 I don't have a key. Henrik has the main one I think
The spare is in my desk with the board papers. I can bring it to the plot tomorrow around 10 if someone is there

[photo: padlock]
the lock was sticking on tuesday so I sprayed it. Might open now, haven't tried
Ok. Nils, bring the spare tomorrow then 👍
I'll be there
sorry, just up. Main key is in my jacket at home, Sara can grab it. I'm on nights tonight so can't come by
Ok! I'll take it from the jacket before I go to bed
break. Axel did the lock fine? if it's still sticky just leave the padlock off the hasp and we'll look at it Monday
It opens. Grease did it. The water sensor on my plot is still logging weird readings though, not sure why
Is the autumn work day still Sat 5 Dec or did it move? Need to tell the list 🌱
Hej 😊 I have the main key. Took it from the jacket last night, it's in my bag
Work day is 5 Dec I think, it's in the October minutes. I can check
Ok, 5 Dec then. Sara can you put it in the notice 👍
Ok!
Spare key: Mon 10 at the plot as I said. Who will be there with me? Don't want to stand at the gate
I'll come by at 10 if I can. Walk first
Good. Axel, you'll be there? You asked about the water bill

[photo: logger screen]
sorry, between lab and project group. This is last night's readings. Flat at 0, then spikes to about 900 l/h for a minute, then back to 0. 4 times
Could be the logger, could be someone opening a tap on the main line. Not sure
If the readings are wrong we can dispute it with the utility, but only with the actual meter numbers from October. Don't guess. Send me the figures when you have them
break. Are you sure it's not the pressure valve at the tap? That one bangs when the pump kicks in. The blue one
Hadn't thought of that. Will look Monday before class. Won't touch the valve before someone who knows it is there
ok. Don't open it by yourself, Monday I'll show you. I'm sleeping in the day so Nils or Sara can be there too
Hej 😊 I'm at the office by 8. Henrik is home and asleep. Can someone send me a photo of the gate board when they pass it? I need the 5 Dec notice up today

[photo: blue valve]
the blue one. Not banging right now, pump is off. I'm at the tap until 9 then class
At the gate. Going in now
Walking in. Cat sat at the window until I put my coat on 🌱
Shed is open with the spare. Axel, the sticky padlock is fine now
Pressure at the tap 3.4 bar with the pump running. Drops to 2.9 after. Going to class, will check the logger tonight
Good. Write the time with each reading, Axel. Send me the list and I'll put it next to the October meter numbers

[photo: shed open, rakes and barrow out]
Tool shed ok 👍
Ok. Who puts the notice on the gate board? I'll send the text to the list tonight
I can 🌱 I'm here till about 11
Between lectures. Will send the readings tonight
Out of work. I can come to the plot later in the week if needed. Did the gate board get the notice?
Not yet. The board is locked and the key is with Nils, so Wed 👍 bl.a.
I'll put it up Wed. Spare key is back in the desk drawer
up. Axel did you look at the valve?
Yes. Blue one, pump off it was quiet. Pump on it bangs at 3.4. Didn't touch it
ok. That's the pressure relief, not a leak. Loose bang is normal-ish. I'm on tonight. Thu I'm off, we look at it then if you're at the plot
Thu works
Ingrid says the plum tree at the back is dropping fruit on the path. Who has the pruning list this year?
